items.title: 68145_Jimmie Rowles oral history interview
items.q: 'If I were to see him... I'd kiss him and hug him. 'Cause I loved him. Everybody loved him. Everybody that knew him loved him.'

ctx.x: Because a lot of people think he didn't really start until after he had that unfortunate experience in the Army and all that.

No-no. He went in the Army drunk. Marvelous, marvelous, marvelous... If I were to see him, if he were to walk in here this day, I'd kiss him and hug him. 'Cause I loved him. Everybody loved him. Everybody that knew him loved him. You had to understand him. These other guys that would come out there with blood in their eye, ready to blow him out because he didn't play like Hawkins, they didn't understand him. They didn't know what kind of a person... He was a different person.
